rationale: A is more useful because it gives a clear two-feature recommendation directly tied to first-month reach: shareability for acquisition and faster load time to preserve the viral loop. It also includes at least one concrete quantitative claim about abandonment from slow loads. B names two priorities, but its rationale is incomplete and muddled, with weak comparison between customization, load time, and partnerships. B does handle one uncertainty better by noting partnerships only make sense if already confirmed, but overall it offers less discriminative reasoning and less actionable support for the actual choice.
